set.body: During release-tooling validation on 2026-10-21, the unchanged 217de27e baseline and patched-Pillow candidate both failed the same 105 unittest failure/error entries (97 failures, 8 errors, 56 tests). Root cause: comparison manifest source fingerprints are stale (first error source changed: frame); 20 eyes4s source files differ from its October 5 inventory snapshot. Comparator files must be checked against the pinned wheel, not the checkout root. Review changed APIs/capability claims and current source anchors; issue a new reviewed source-bound inventory and regenerate its table. Preserve historical receipts, reject stale empirical receipts, and run test_check.py plus the live checker. Never blanket-rehash old evidence to imply empirical qualification. Separate performance-protocol generator binding drift is being reviewed and repaired with the Pillow tooling slice.
set.title: Review and refresh the stale pymovements capability source inventory
